title: NovelAI (novelai/spec/**/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under novelai/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to novelai/spec/ without .json is the spec id. Output filename_prefix is that id (nested folders preserved). Tag arrays for NovelAI Diffusion. Omit img2img for txt2img; set it for Image2Image. When omitted, model is nai-diffusion-5-full, sampler is k_euler_ancestral, steps is 28, and scale is 5.

model.description: NovelAI Diffusion API model name. When omitted, nai-diffusion-5-full is used.

image_size.description: Output dimensions (width x height). Official Small/Normal/Large presets: Small 512x768, 768x512, 640x640; Normal 832x1216, 1216x832, 1024x1024; Large 1024x1536, 1536x1024, 1472x1472. Opus Anlas-free generations are Normal or smaller, 28 steps or fewer, and one image per request. Image2Image still uses this size.

img2img.description: Image2Image source and Strength/Noise. Omit for txt2img. Official Strength and Noise apply only when a source image is used.

positive.description: Base positive prompt tags, joined with ', ' for NovelAI. Scene, style, and count tags such as 2girls. Empty emits no positive tags.

negative.description: Base negative prompt tags, joined with ', ' for NovelAI. Empty emits no negative tags.

characters.description: Character prompts for V4+ multi-character generation. Omitted or empty sends no character prompts. When use_order is true, array order is a placement signal (left to right, top to bottom). Optional x and y (0-1) enable Custom Positions; omit both for AI's Choice. V5 models allow up to 22; V4.5 models allow up to 6. Count tags such as 2girls belong in positive, not here.

use_order.description: When true, character prompt order is a placement signal (left to right, top to bottom). When omitted, true is used. Keep it consistent with x/y when using Custom Positions. Official clients usually leave this true.

sampler.description: NovelAI sampler. When omitted, k_euler_ancestral is used.

steps.description: Sampling steps. When omitted, 28 is used. Opus Anlas-free generations require 28 or fewer.

scale.description: Prompt guidance. When omitted, 5 is used.

image.description: Source image path for Image2Image. PNG, JPEG, or WEBP. Resolved relative to the process working directory when not absolute.

strength.description: How much the prompt may change the source composition. Lower stays closer to the source. When omitted, 0.7 is used.

noise.description: Extra detail versus artifacts. When omitted, 0 is used.

positive.description: Character prompt tags, joined with ', ' for NovelAI. Use girl, boy, or other without a count. Empty emits no character tags.

negative.description: Character undesired-content tags, joined with ', ' for NovelAI. Empty emits no character undesired tags.

x.description: Horizontal position from 0 (left) to 1 (right). Omit with y for AI's Choice. When set, y is required. V5 is free placement; V4.5 is a 5x5 grid on NovelAI's side.

y.description: Vertical position from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom). Omit with x for AI's Choice. When set, x is required.
